messages:
Elaine: ⚠️ Quick one — did anyone veto the trade Sam proposed in the fantasy league? It's the 2-for-1 keeper swap (M. Thomas + waiver pick -> C. Rivera). Feels like a heist. 🕵️‍♀️
Sam G: Not vetoed yet. I put it in at 10:02pm last night. Looks fair to me — opens up cap for playoffs.
Priya: I voted no veto because I need the pick. But tbh surprised Jordan didn't flag the keeper rule.
Jordan: flagged now. The keeper rule says you can't trade a keeper until week 10 — this was week 8. 🤦‍♂️
Mike: oh oops. didn't see that in the rules. can we undo? what's the undo workflow?
Elaine: @OpsBot can you roll back trades made in violation? ` /undo_trade 54321 `
OpsBot: Received request to rollback trade 54321. Pending approval from league-commissioner. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Priya: commissioner here — I'll approve rollback. but Sam pls no hard feelings, find another deal!
Sam G: all good. I had a sneaky backup plan anyway 😂
Jordan: also — MVP side bet still stands. whoever gets most points this week buys burritos.
Elaine: stakes raised: if buddy with worst waiver wire score loses, they bring breakfast.
Mike: bargain. I accept burritos. Also, here's the rule excerpt I pasted earlier:
```nKeeper trades prohibited until Week 10.
Violations are automatically rolled back by commissioner intervention.
```
Sam G: noted. Thanks for catching @Jordan. Also who wants to form a 'late-night waiver' Slack thread tomorrow? 💤
Priya: count me in. Also +1 for burritos.
Elaine: cool. I'll mark trade 54321 as rolled back once OpsBot confirms. :checkered_flag:
